channel.title: Relay Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for Relay on macOS.

item.description:
# Relay 0.3.11
- Click a Contacts search result once to open its card in Contacts and close Relay's command window. - Pressing Enter continues to open the selected contact. Contact results also support direct accessibility activation. - Contact searching, permissions and all other result actions retain their existing behavior.
For Intel and Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Your existing Relay library, settings and Contacts permission are preserved.

# Relay 0.3.10
- Search your Contacts in All, alongside apps, settings, files and saved items. - Find names, nicknames, organizations, email addresses and phone numbers. Name matching ignores case/accents and supports Greek names typed in Latin characters. - Press Enter on a contact to open it in Contacts and close the launcher. - Enable access through the Enable Contacts search result or Settings → General → This Mac. Relay uses macOS permission and searches locally; it does not upload contact details. - Phone numbers can match contacts alongside the calculator. Explicit currency and unit conversions retain their existing behavior.
For Intel and Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Your existing Relay library and preferences are preserved.

Relay 0.3.9 improves opening Relay on your current desktop.
- The command bar, clipboard picker, library and image windows move to the desktop you are currently using when opened. - Opening Relay again brings up the command bar even when another Relay window exists on a different desktop. - Open editor dialogs and shortcut recording are preserved.
Includes the friendly application and product-name search improvements from 0.3.8. Signed and notarized universal Mac app. Requires macOS 14 or later. Existing library and preferences are preserved.
